name: grandma-mali-build
description: Offline build of public/models/grandma-mali.glb (not part of the game build).

scripts.build: node build.mjs --raw ../meshy/raw-bigface --pbr ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-ultra.glb && node build.mjs --raw ../meshy/raw-bigface --parametric --pbr --tex 2048 ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-parametric.glb && node build.mjs --raw ../meshy/raw-bigface --remesh --pbr ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-remesh-6k.glb && node build.mjs --raw ../meshy/raw-bigface --remesh ../meshy/raw-bigface/grandma-bigface-remesh-1k5.glb --pbr --tex 1024 ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-remesh-1k5.glb
scripts.lods: node build.mjs --tris 6000 --bake ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-6k.glb && node build.mjs --remesh ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-remesh-6k.glb && node build.mjs --tris 3000 --bake ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-3k.glb && node build.mjs --tris 1500 --bake ../../../public/models/grandma-mali-1k5.glb
